body:
M10 is landed and pushed. Your HANDOFF block is written; TASK_M10 is closed. The falling-runway = DIM call stands as specced, and your SELECT correction is recorded - it supersedes the land finding I wrote against M9.

WHERE THE FILES GO. You already did this right on M10; this is the standing rule so no future pack needs a land step at all.

1. Spec -> research/<ID>_<TITLE>.md  (e.g. research/M10_THE_BOOKS_THE_SCREEN.md)
2. Land note -> research/CLAUDE_LAND_NOTE_<ID>.md
3. Boards -> DesignLibrary/screens/<surface>/<id>_NN_name.png, lowercase id, zero-padded, beside the pack they extend (m10_* went beside m8_* - exactly right). One new folder per NEW surface only.
4. Commit those three groups yourself and push them on master. That IS the delivery.

WHAT NOT TO SEND. _maria_delivery/ is staging and is never committed - it has never been in the repo and I am adding it to .gitignore so a broad git add cannot sweep it in. Do not zip a pack for me to extract: a zip I have to unpack is a step that can go wrong, and the extracted files are what the repo needs. If you want a zip for your own archive, leave it in _maria_delivery/ and do not mention it in the land steps. Never commit assets ripped from another game (CLAUDE.md), and never a runtime bitmap intended for import - boards are reference, code-drawn from UITokens.

WHAT I STILL DO. I write your HANDOFF block, I close the task, and I verify your engine claims against the code before landing. Keep naming the constants and the read functions by name - that check is only cheap because you do.

One correction from the M10 land check, for whoever builds the screen: Sponsorship.gd:209 pays tier + (roll % 3) * 25, so 250/400/650/1000 are the tier BASE, not necessarily the cheque. The build must read the amount.
topic: M10 LANDED - and where to put files from now on
